correctness.rationale: Every edge is partitioned into spine, smaller-center leaf, larger-center leaf. Spine edges satisfy the published degree-two lemma. Pendant deletion yields exact resolvent and path-continuant comparisons; the strict interior sign follows from t>sqrt(e+2)≥2 and a positive quadratic expression. Low-center and balanced cases have explicit preserving/improving reconnections. The executable independently tests all legal swaps for 75 finite triples. Boundaries ell≥2 and a,b≥2 are explicit.

value.rationale: Complete three-parameter classification of a canonical infinite family directly motivated by the new 2026 spectral sustainability problem, including a sharp degree-imbalance transition and exact identification of every indispensable edge. Unlike high-maximum-degree non-sustainability, this handles arbitrarily long connecting spines at fixed imbalance and distinguishes subdivided versus unsubdivided double stars.
